items.statement: Build equipment so that surfaces in contact with components, in-process materials or drug products are not reactive, additive or absorptive in a way that would alter the drug product's safety, identity, strength, quality or purity beyond official or other established requirements.
items.quote: Equipment shall be constructed so that surfaces that contact components, in-process materials, or drug products shall not be reactive, additive, or absorptive so as to alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug product beyond the official or other established requirements.

items.statement: Prevent substances needed to operate equipment, such as lubricants or coolants, from contacting components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials or drug products in a way that would alter the drug product's safety, identity, strength, quality or purity beyond official or other established requirements.
items.quote: Any substances required for operation, such as lubricants or coolants, shall not come into contact with components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, or drug products so as to alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug product beyond the official or other established requirements.

items.statement: Clean and maintain equipment and utensils, and sanitize and/or sterilize them as appropriate for the nature of the drug, at appropriate intervals to prevent malfunctions or contamination that would alter the drug product's safety, identity, strength, quality or purity beyond official or other established requirements.
items.quote: Equipment and utensils shall be cleaned, maintained, and, as appropriate for the nature of the drug, sanitized and/or sterilized at appropriate intervals to prevent malfunctions or contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug product beyond the official or other established requirements.
items.condition: sanitizing/sterilizing as appropriate for the nature of the drug

items.statement: Establish and follow written procedures for cleaning and maintaining equipment, including utensils, used to manufacture, process, pack or hold a drug product.
items.quote: Written procedures shall be established and followed for cleaning and maintenance of equipment, including utensils, used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product.

items.statement: Make the written equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures include, at a minimum, the elements listed in the following items (responsibilities, schedules, methods, removal of previous batch identification, protection of clean equipment, pre-use inspection).
items.quote: These procedures shall include, but are not necessarily limited to, the following:

items.statement: Written equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures assign responsibility for cleaning and maintaining equipment.
items.quote: Assignment of responsibility for cleaning and maintaining equipment;

items.statement: Written equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures include maintenance and cleaning schedules and, where appropriate, sanitizing schedules.
items.quote: Maintenance and cleaning schedules, including, where appropriate, sanitizing schedules;

items.statement: Written equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures describe in enough detail the methods, equipment and materials used for cleaning and maintenance, and how to take apart and reassemble equipment as needed to ensure proper cleaning and maintenance.
items.quote: A description in sufficient detail of the methods, equipment, and materials used in cleaning and maintenance operations, and the methods of disassembling and reassembling equipment as necessary to assure proper cleaning and maintenance;

items.statement: Written equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures cover removing or obliterating the previous batch's identification.
items.quote: Removal or obliteration of previous batch identification;

items.statement: Written equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures cover protecting cleaned equipment from contamination before it is used.
items.quote: Protection of clean equipment from contamination prior to use;

items.statement: Written equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures require inspecting equipment for cleanliness immediately before use.
items.quote: Inspection of equipment for cleanliness immediately before use.

items.statement: Keep records of equipment maintenance, cleaning, sanitizing and inspection, in line with the requirements for general records and equipment cleaning and use logs.
items.quote: Records shall be kept of maintenance, cleaning, sanitizing, and inspection as specified in §§ 211.180 and 211.182.

items.statement: Automatic, mechanical or electronic equipment or other equipment, including computers or related systems, that will perform a function satisfactorily may be used to manufacture, process, pack and hold a drug product.
items.quote: Automatic, mechanical, or electronic equipment or other types of equipment, including computers, or related systems that will perform a function satisfactorily, may be used in the manufacture, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product.
items.condition: if it performs its function satisfactorily

items.statement: Where automatic, mechanical or electronic equipment (including computers) is used, calibrate, inspect or check it routinely under a written program designed to assure proper performance.
items.quote: If such equipment is so used, it shall be routinely calibrated, inspected, or checked according to a written program designed to assure proper performance.

items.statement: Maintain written records of the calibration checks and inspections of automatic, mechanical or electronic equipment.
items.quote: Written records of those calibration checks and inspections shall be maintained.

items.statement: Exercise appropriate controls over computer or related systems so that only authorized personnel make changes to master production and control records or other records.
items.quote: Appropriate controls shall be exercised over computer or related systems to assure that changes in master production and control records or other records are instituted only by authorized personnel.

items.statement: Check the accuracy of formulas or other records or data entered into and produced by computer or related systems.
items.quote: Input to and output from the computer or related system of formulas or other records or data shall be checked for accuracy.

items.statement: Base the degree and frequency of computer input/output verification on the complexity and reliability of the computer or related system.
items.quote: The degree and frequency of input/output verification shall be based on the complexity and reliability of the computer or related system.

items.statement: Maintain a backup file of data entered into computer or related systems, except where certain data (such as calculations for laboratory analysis) are eliminated by computerization or other automated processes.
items.quote: A backup file of data entered into the computer or related system shall be maintained except where certain data, such as calculations performed in connection with laboratory analysis, are eliminated by computerization or other automated processes.
items.condition: unless data are eliminated by computerization or automated processes

items.statement: Where data such as laboratory calculations are eliminated by computerization or other automated processes, maintain a written record of the program together with appropriate validation data.
items.quote: In such instances a written record of the program shall be maintained along with appropriate validation data.
items.condition: where data are eliminated by computerization or automated processes

items.statement: Maintain hard copy or alternative systems (such as duplicates, tapes or microfilm) designed to assure backup data are exact, complete and secure from alteration, inadvertent erasure or loss.
items.quote: Hard copy or alternative systems, such as duplicates, tapes, or microfilm, designed to assure that backup data are exact and complete and that it is secure from alteration, inadvertent erasures, or loss shall be maintained.

items.statement: Automated equipment may replace the second-person check for operations such as component weighing and addition, yield calculation, equipment cleaning and use logging, and batch record verification steps, if the equipment is used in conformity with the requirements for automatic, mechanical and electronic equipment and one person checks that the equipment performed the operation properly.
items.quote: Such automated equipment used for performance of operations addressed by §§ 211.101(c) or (d), 211.103, 211.182, or 211.188(b)(11) can satisfy the requirements included in those sections relating to the performance of an operation by one person and checking by another person if such equipment is used in conformity with this section, and one person checks that the equipment properly performed the operation.
items.condition: if equipment used in conformity with requirements and one person checks it performed properly

items.statement: Ensure filters used for liquid filtration in manufacturing, processing or packing injectable drug products for human use do not release fibers into those products.
items.quote: Filters for liquid filtration used in the manufacture, processing, or packing of injectable drug products intended for human use shall not release fibers into such products.
items.condition: injectable drug products for human use

items.statement: Fiber-releasing filters may be used for injectable drug products for human use when those products cannot be manufactured without them.
items.quote: Fiber-releasing filters may be used when it is not possible to manufacture such products without the use of these filters.
items.condition: when manufacture is not possible without them

items.statement: If a fiber-releasing filter must be used for an injectable drug product, follow it with an additional non-fiber-releasing filter with a maximum nominal pore size rating of 0.2 micron (0.45 micron if manufacturing conditions so dictate) to reduce particle content.
items.quote: If use of a fiber-releasing filter is necessary, an additional nonfiber-releasing filter having a maximum nominal pore size rating of 0.2 micron (0.45 micron if the manufacturing conditions so dictate) shall subsequently be used to reduce the content of particles in the injectable drug product.
items.condition: if a fiber-releasing filter is necessary

items.statement: Do not use asbestos-containing filters in liquid filtration of injectable drug products for human use.
items.quote: The use of an asbestos-containing filter is prohibited.

items.statement: Have and follow written procedures describing in sufficient detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, testing, and approval or rejection of components and drug product containers and closures.
items.quote: There shall be written procedures describing in sufficient detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, testing, and approval or rejection of components and drug product containers and closures; such written procedures shall be followed.

items.statement: Handle and store components and drug product containers and closures at all times so as to prevent contamination.
items.quote: Components and drug product containers and closures shall at all times be handled and stored in a manner to prevent contamination.

items.statement: Store bagged or boxed components, drug product containers or closures off the floor and suitably spaced to allow cleaning and inspection.
items.quote: Bagged or boxed components of drug product containers, or closures shall be stored off the floor and suitably spaced to permit cleaning and inspection.

items.statement: Identify each container or group of containers of components, drug product containers or closures with a distinctive code for each lot in each shipment received.
items.quote: Each container or grouping of containers for components or drug product containers, or closures shall be identified with a distinctive code for each lot in each shipment received.

items.statement: Use the distinctive lot code when recording the disposition of each lot of components, drug product containers or closures.
items.quote: This code shall be used in recording the disposition of each lot.

items.statement: Identify each lot of components, drug product containers or closures appropriately with its status: quarantined, approved or rejected.
items.quote: Each lot shall be appropriately identified as to its status (i.e., quarantined, approved, or rejected).
